title: faceto model.json
description: The authoring/bootstrap source format for a faceto event-storming board — a typed JSON file you think through with an LLM. Parsed by `model::from_json`. Every top-level field is optional (an empty object `{}` is a valid, empty board); unknown fields are ignored by design (forward compatibility), so this schema is deliberately permissive (`additionalProperties: true`). The durable record is the derived append-only `<name>.event-log.jsonl`, not this file.

title.description: Board title. Defaults to "board" when absent.

level.description: Modeling granularity — use one of these two. `design` turns on stricter lint rules (e.g. a command with no output is flagged); `big-picture` is the default when the field is absent. (The parser is lenient — it maps any non-"design" string to big-picture — but author only these two.)

phases.description: Labelled vertical bands (regions / bounded contexts) over the column timeline. On load they are normalized into a gap-free, overlap-free partition, so authored bands may be adjusted to fit.

elements.description: The stickies. Each is placed by `type` (its lane) and `col` (its point on the shared timeline).

edges.description: Directed connections between elements, as positional tuples.

elementType.description: Selects the lane AND the colour from the fixed 8-lane event-storming grammar. An off-grammar value does not crash but has no lane and renders drably — stay within the enum.

phase.description: A vertical band spanning columns [fromCol, toCol] across all lanes. A band missing any of the three required fields is dropped on load.

id.description: Stable region identity (the diff/resize/rename/remove key). Omit to have a deterministic `K<n>` id minted on load; convention: never renumber an id, only add.

fromCol.description: Left column of the band (inclusive), on the shared timeline.

element.description: One sticky. An element missing any of `id` / `type` / `label` (or with a non-string value there) is dropped on load.

id.description: Stable identity — the comment join key AND the diff key. Never derived from text or position; never renumbered, only added. Convention: a `type`-prefixed letter + number (E2, C3, …), but any unique string is accepted.

col.description: Global timeline coordinate shared across ALL lanes (left→right = time), NOT a per-lane index. Order within a lane is just sort-by-col. Omit to auto-assign in file order.

detail.description: Optional smaller second line under the label. A trailing `(parenthetical)` in the label becomes this too.

y.description: Stored vertical sub-position WITHIN the lane band, as a fraction of the band interior. Omit for auto-stacking. Never identity (id is), never a lane choice (type is).

resolved.description: For a `hotspot`: when true it goes quiet (grey + check) instead of loud red.

links.description: Attached reference URLs (F-element-links): tickets, docs, ADRs. Surfaced as clickable chips in the click modal, not painted on the board. Non-string entries are dropped on load.

edge.description: A directed edge, in either form: a positional tuple `[src, dst]` / `[src, dst, status]`, OR an object `{src, dst, label}` (F-element-links: the object form carries an authored `label`). `src` and `dst` are element ids. (Note: in the EVENT LOG, edges are objects `{src, dst, label?}` — see event-log-line.schema.json.)

oneOf.description: Tuple form. A tuple with fewer than 2 string ids is dropped on load. The optional third slot is the internal diff `status`, not an authored field.

prefixItems.description: internal diff status (added/removed/…), written by diff_models — not an authored field

oneOf.description: Object form (F-element-links). The seam F-typed-edges extends with a future `type`.

label.description: optional human label, drawn at the edge midpoint
